text: Nigeria's first autonomous delivery fleet is live. Built end-to-end in Lagos.
Most robotics startups in Africa die in the demo stage. We just took ours into a live warehouse.
62 out of 62 units passed the V3 drop test. Every chassis cleared 1.8 metres onto concrete.
Fleet control shipped to production this morning. Navigation, power and the operator console are all live.
Hardware is just software that has to survive the rain.
author: LUCID LABS LTD · FIELD NOTE 04
